description: Gross revenue and order counts per currency and connection for a period. Confirmed imported duplicates (e.g. Base orders imported from Allegro) are excluded; potential duplicates are included but reported separately. Cancelled, refunded and (by default) unpaid orders are excluded. This is revenue, not profit; currencies are never converted.

connectionIds.description: Connection ids to include (see commerce_list_connections). Omit for all connections.

date.description: A single local calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit with no other range = today so far.

days.description: Last N local days including today so far.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for day boundaries, e.g. Europe/Warsaw. Defaults to the server timezone.

name: commerce_sales_summary
title: Sales summary without double counting
